episodes.synopsis: Shion has successfully booted the upgraded mass biometric analytical  system for locating Momo Yozakura, Old Man Hunter 2. While she searches, Taiyo attempts to take his skills to the next level so that he can hold his own against Momo. Thanks to Kyoichiro's spartan training and Kai's support, Taiyo discovers his own way of fighting while manifesting Profuse Blooming of 10,000 Flowers. Just then, Shion reports that she's pinpointed Momo's location! The Yozakuras and the Gold Rank spies mobilize to bring Futaba and Shinzo home!
episodes.title: Mission: Sibling Retrieval

episodes.synopsis: Kengo and Taiyo face off against the brainwashed Shinzo in a basement-level hallway of the Kaioumaru. As Shinzo's fighting seriously, now that he's activated his Blooming, they're purely on the defensive, but when they spot an opening, they try to contain him. Kengo uses his Blooming technique, Assimilation, to reverse the mind control by entering Shinzo's memories. There, he finds the walls plastered with fun-filled memories of Shinzo spending time with the family. As he advances further, he finds Shinzo's more recent memories, redacted by Momo, and Shinzo himself, staring at the monitor with lifeless eyes.
episodes.title: Yozakura Family Feud

episodes.synopsis: Waking up to an ordinary, blissful morning with the family that is no longer with him, Taiyo almost gives in to the deception, even while feeling that something's off. That's when sakura blossoms suddenly start blooming on his hands... When he comes to, Taiyo finds himself trapped by a tentacle growing out of an ominous, giant black sakura tree. Shinzo and Kengo have also been caught, and they're unconscious. And now he's lost contact with Mutsumi and the other siblings! Kai and the other Gold Rank spies can only stand by, unsure of what's going on. To rescue everyone, Taiyo rushes off to find Momo!
episodes.title: Dreams
